description: This header file declares functions related to Lua integration for handling 'liValue' objects within the 'lighttpd' server project, specifically for initializing Lua metatables and converting between Lua stack values and internal 'liValue' representations.

methods.name: li_lua_init_value_mt
methods.description: Initializes the Lua metatable for 'liValue' objects, likely setting up how 'liValue' instances are represented and manipulated within Lua.

methods.name: li_value_from_lua
methods.description: Converts the value at the top of the Lua stack into an internal 'liValue' object for use within the server, popping it from the stack.

methods.name: li_lua_push_value
methods.description: Pushes a given 'liValue' onto the Lua stack, returning 1 on success or pushing nil on failure.

methods.name: li_lua_togstring
methods.description: Converts a Lua value at the specified stack index into an 'GString' representation.
